title: Government's Response to Recommendations for Medishield Life to Better Support Fertility Preservation for Young Cancer Patients
what_it_is: Government's Response to Recommendations for Medishield Life to Better Support Fertility Preservation for Young Cancer Patients

sections.label: Egg use and fertility support
sections.summary: Patients who marry later can get Government co-funding and MediSave for Assisted Reproduction, with possible extra support studied separately from the MediShield Life 2024 review.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: If they get married in the future and would like to use their eggs for Assisted Reproduction treatments, they can also receive Government co-funding support and use MediSave for their treatments.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We will study extending more support for such patients, separately from the MediShield Life 2024 review, bearing in mind there may be other medically necessary treatments for conditions besides cancer that could also affect fertility.

sections.label: MediShield Life and fertility co-funding
sections.summary: MediShield Life covers large subsidised public hospital bills, and the Government will review support and co-funding adequacy for cancer patients' fertility treatments.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: MediShield Life is designed as a basic insurance scheme, covering large bills due to treatment of diseases in subsidised public hospitals.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We have also taken note of some of the suggestions Dr Tan has made in his Adjournment Motion.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We will be looking at how we can continue to provide more support and see what is the adequacy of co-funding of other support that we can provide in fertility treatments of cancer patients.
